subject: Project Orion: model shortlist & token-profile handoff
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@orionai.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Project Orion — initial workload profile and kickoff

Hi Lukas / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to move towards a quick onboarding run for Project Orion — core asks below so your implementation team can propose a model shortlist and a sizing readout: 

- Workload profile: ~12M user queries/month, avg user prompt length ~75 tokens, expected model-generated length ~180 tokens.
- Traffic shape: peak concurrency targeting ~50 rps with occasional spikes to ~120 rps for short periods.
- Context needs: many calls include a system + 3 turn history; max sequence we need to preserve is ~4k tokens for the longest flows, but 2k covers 85% of traffic.
- Quality bar: strong instruction-following for summarization and Q&A; hallucination risk must be low on factual retrievals.
- Security: data-in-transit must be TLS; we may require Private deployment if we exceed certain data residency thresholds.

Please share: 1) a short model shortlist (3–4 candidates) with pros/cons re: latency and cost, 2) token volume estimates (monthly input vs output tokens) and 3) recommended runtime (hosted vs dedicated) for predictable latency.

We also want a mutual action plan and to kick off the implementation call next week if possible. Attaching a small CSV with our sample daily traffic (summary).

Attached: sample_traffic_summary.csv (text/csv)

Thanks,
Samir
Director of Product
Orion AI
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@orionai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Project Orion — initial workload profile and kickoff

Samir — thanks for the detail, this is very helpful. Looping in Monica (CS) and Ben (solutions) to align on rollout. Below is an initial take; I'll produce a short spreadsheet with the token math and a recommended mutual action plan by Monday.

Quick shortlist (3 candidates) with rationale: 

1) Mistral-Instruct-7B (quantized q4) — Pros: excellent instruction-following for summarization, low token-cost and good latency at small batch sizes; Cons: context window typically 4k, may need pinned KV caching for long histories. Good candidate if 85% of traffic stays under 2k.

2) Llama-3-8B-instruct (8k variant) — Pros: native 8k context supports your 4k worst-case sequences comfortably, robust on Q&A; Cons: slightly higher token cost and greater memory footprint; with batching we can keep latency acceptable.

3) Falcon-40B-Instruct (quantized) — Pros: strong zero-shot reasoning and quality; Cons: needs larger GPU footprint, higher per-token cost, but useful as a fallback for high-cost/low-latency tolerant flows or for canary testing on Dedicated.

Initial sizing notes (based on your numbers):
- Monthly tokens (rough): 12M queries * (75 input + 180 output) = ~3.06B tokens/month.
- Adjusted for metadata/overhead and retries, plan for 3.4B tokens/month.
- Peak provisioning: to support 120 rps peak with a ~250ms P95 generation latency target we'll need routing and batching tuned; Dedicated pool of 4-6 A100-equivalent instances (or hosted equivalent with autoscale buffer) is a starting point.

Recommendations:
- Start hosted with Mistral-Instruct-7B q4 for cost-controlled baseline and run a 2-week traffic shadow to validate quality.
- If 4k context usage is frequent (>20% of calls), plan to switch to Llama-3-8k variant and prewarm KV caches; this is where Dedicated makes sense for consistent latency.

Attachments I will share: a short worksheet (orion_model_shortlist.xlsx) with token breakdowns per candidate and a token_profile_estimates.csv. Also drafting a mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf with kickoff milestones.

Next steps: can we schedule a 60-min implementation kickoff on Tue 30th or Wed 1st? Monica — can you confirm preferred owners for infra prep and test data?

— Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@orionai.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Project Orion — initial workload profile and kickoff

Thanks Samir / Lukas. A few implementation notes from CS/Implementation: 

- Test data: please provide 100 representative threads (de-identified) and a small retrieval bundle if you plan to connect a vector DB. That will let us validate hallucination risk on candidate models.
- Networking: confirm if you'll use a VPC peering path or need Private. For initial shadowing hosted is fine but if procurement needs a Private contract we'll fast-track that.
- Metrics: we'll instrument per-route latency (P50/P95), generation token counts, and hallucination rate on your sample prompts.

I've added owners for the kickoff: 
- Implementation lead: Monica Patel (CS) — infra & test validation
- Solutions/Sales: Ben Carter — commercial & SLA coordination
- Customer PM: Samir Gupta — decision owner

I'll attach the mutual action plan once Lukas shares the worksheet. Tue 30th at 2pm PT works for me for a 60-min slot; Samir, can you confirm?

Monica Patel
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@orionai.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Orion Procurement <procurement@orionai.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Project Orion — initial workload profile and kickoff

Samir — looping in procurement as discussed. We can provision a Hosted PoC immediately; if you move to Dedicated/Private we will provide a cost estimate and the committed capacity options.

Action items before the kickoff: 
- Samir: confirm Tue 30th 2pm PT or propose an alternate slot.
- Samir: upload the 100 de-identified example conversations to the shared Drive link (I'll send an invite).
- Lukas: finalize the worksheet and attach the token math and the mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf.

I'll also confirm whether we can include a 30-day trial credit on usage for the PoC; that requires a short signature on an order form — procurement, can you confirm the PO path?

Thanks — looking forward to getting Orion into a shadow run.

— Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
